body:
Spec: .adlc/specs/install-experience.md (I1 section is binding).

=== CONTEXT ===
skills.sh is vercel-labs/skills (`npx skills add <owner>/<repo>`), reaching ~70 harnesses. It has NO submission process: its FAQ states skills appear on the leaderboard automatically via anonymous telemetry when users run `npx skills add`. Listing is install-driven, so being installable IS being registered. The only human-gated surface is GET /api/v1/skills/curated ("official first-party skills from technology makers"), which is outreach and out of scope here.

The ADLC repo is currently unreachable through that channel. The skills CLI discovers skills in `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, `skills/<category>/<name>/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/`, and `.agents/skills/`. All 24 ADLC SKILL.md files live under `plugins/adlc-<harness>/skills/`, which is not a discovered container, so `npx skills add voodootikigod/adlc` finds nothing.

A skills.sh install delivers SKILLS ONLY -- no hooks, no MCP tools, no agents, no rails enforcement. It is a strictly weaker install than any native plugin and must be positioned as an on-ramp, never as the recommended path (ADR-0009 Decision 4, claim accuracy).

=== TASK ===
1. Add a top-level `skills/` catalog of harness-neutral ADLC skills, starting with the phase router at `skills/adlc/SKILL.md`. Neutral means: no `/adlc:*`, no `$adlc-*`, no `/adlc-*`; the only dependency is `adlc <tool>` on PATH.
2. Add `test/skills-catalog.test.mjs` with three cases -- frontmatter validity, neutrality (no harness-specific invocation syntax), and drift (every P0-P7 phase label and every gate tool name in plugins/adlc-claude-code/skills/adlc/SKILL.md also appears in skills/adlc/SKILL.md).
3. Add a `scripts/skills-add-smoke.mjs` network smoke that runs `npx --yes skills add ./` against a temporary HOME. Not part of the offline unit suite.
4. Document the channel and its limits in README.md and the integrations index, using the phrase "skills only" and claiming no hooks/MCP/rails coverage. Add the honesty case to the test.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1.1: skills/adlc/SKILL.md exists with valid non-empty name and description frontmatter. VERIFY: `node --test test/skills-catalog.test.mjs` frontmatter case passes.
- AC1.2: No skills/**/SKILL.md contains /adlc:, $adlc-, or /adlc-. VERIFY: `node --test test/skills-catalog.test.mjs` neutrality case passes.
- AC1.3: Dropping a gate name from either skills/adlc/SKILL.md or the Claude Code router fails the drift case. VERIFY: `node --test test/skills-catalog.test.mjs` drift case passes, and the mutation is demonstrated to fail it.
- AC1.4: `npx --yes skills add ./` resolves the catalog. VERIFY: `node scripts/skills-add-smoke.mjs` exits 0 with adlc named in stdout.
- AC1.5: Every file naming skills.sh contains "skills only" in the same section and claims no hooks/MCP/rails for that channel. VERIFY: `node --test test/skills-catalog.test.mjs` honesty case passes.
title: Make ADLC installable from skills.sh via a harness-neutral top-level skills/ catalog
